name: Centre de Yoga Iyengar de Toulouse (Association Yoga Huit)
reason: Too thin: its own site (yogaiyengartoulouse.fr, a Duda site; robots.txt allows us) has only two item pages, the general classes-and-workshops page and the enrolment page (trial class 10 €, membership 22 €); the term prices, the class timetable and the dated workshop programme are all PDFs on de.cdn-website.com, whose robots.txt request is refused (403), so they were not opened, and its introductory pages are framed on health benefits. Otherwise a sound centre: an association teaching the Iyengar method for 30 years at 23 rue des Lois, Toulouse, with Pune-certified teachers and a published email (yogahuit@free.fr) and contact form.
